title: Unit Event — Our Constellation of Song — Episode4 Those We Owe It To

meta.Episode: Episode4 — Those We Owe It To
meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has done it at last. They've been signed by a record label! Reflecting on all of the people whose support has taken them this far, Ichika thinks of a way for the band to show their gratitude.

rows.Line: A few days later
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sorry for running late, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's okay. I just got here too.
Thank you for always taking time out of your busy schedule to practice with me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, don't mind me. I didn't have much going on today. All I really did was make a list of stage props.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, wanna get started...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, before we do...!
There's something I need to give you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here, it's a ticket for our next show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know you saw our solo show, but I'm really hoping that you'll also come to this one.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, but...! You don't have to if you already have plans!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I've been looking forward to going to your next show since your solo show was so much fun. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm really glad to hear that...!
Thank you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But wow, you're doing another show already.
Your band must be doing pretty well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, because of our supporters...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our next show is going to be our way of thanking everyone who's been there for us until now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why, Kusanagi, I'd like for you to come...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, since you've been teaching me how to sing. And...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because you've been supporting my dream. As my friend.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you. I really appreciate what you're saying, but... I need to thank you as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Well, um... I'm pretty shy around others and all...
Which is why I'm happy that I've gotten to know you so well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And seeing you really go after your dream has motivated me to do the same, Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So you've been supporting my dream a lot as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not missing your show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm so glad I never stopped singing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
Singing's sort of the reason we became friends.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We go to different schools, so we probably never would've met under normal circumstances...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But that time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
When I heard you sing, I was really touched!
I want to be able to sing like you too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: L-Like me...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So if you don't mind... Can you please teach me how to sing?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We were able to become friends because you were willing to ask me to teach you how to sing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(She's right...
Singing is what brought us together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm really glad that I started taking singing more seriously after getting our band back together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Kusanagi.
Thank you so much for everything you've taught me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-You're welcome...
But it's a little embarrassing when you put it that way...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, wanna start practicing...?
A few days later
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would it be possible for you to come see our show?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A show for us...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be more than happy to go since you've invited me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But have I really done anything worthy of being thanked?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, Kanade, don't say that...!
You've taught me so much about writing songs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You made me realize some very important things that time...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Important things...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. How to bring what I'm feeling into shape... And the importance of having the courage to believe in my choices.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That didn't just help me finish that song... What I learned that day will stick with me as I keep thinking about our music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't think I did anything particularly profound.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm glad I could help you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to the show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
I promise to do my very best to make sure you enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Thank goodness...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I also need to do my best to put on a good show for her.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Kusanagi was right.
I'm so glad I never stopped singing or playing music...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(It's not just her.
Music is what led me to Kanade, too.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Did something happen, Ichika?
You seem awfully happy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was just thinking about how music gave me the opportunity to meet you, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, Kusanagi and I sort of ended up talking about that when I went to invite her the other day...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How singing... How music helped expand our circle of friends.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That made me realize how music has the power to bring people together and create new connections.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I suppose you're right.
After all, that Miku CD was what led to us meeting in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... Yes, I remember.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That CD is what led to us talking like this, and then you taught me how to create my own Miku songs...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Miku's certainly had quite an impact.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, she has...
I mean, Kanade and I do talk about her a lot.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. Then, in other words...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Miku is in essence the one who brought you two together, no?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(She might be right...
Miku's the reason why Kanade and I are friends at all...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (No, not just her...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Meeting Miku in SEKAI brought us back together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (After the four of us reformed our band, we started meeting so many different people.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Oh, that reminds me...
When we were little, we decided to start a band because I'd listened to all those Miku songs and wanted to play them.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're absolutely right, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Music has given me a chance to meet all these people.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But Miku stands at the center of all that. She brought us all together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: In that case, Hoshino, it sounds like Miku's had the biggest impact on your life...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika's Voice
rows.Line: ...! Wow! She's so amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I think you're right...!
